integrity: Explicit constructions and full finite exhaustive graph-search source are supplied; the proof of search completeness uses proper-coloring bounds and complete branching. Independently audited scientific correctness is not asserted.
scientific_limitations: Only binary, one deletion and at most one substitution, five distinct reads, lengths four through eight; no values at larger lengths and no uniqueness classification. Finite graph enumerations are exhaustive for the stated domains only.
title: Exact five-read binary mixed-error reconstruction capacities through length eight
